title: Microsoft Teams: Miracast support for Teams Rooms on Windows devices
description: In addition to Teams Cast and HDMI ingest; you are able to share wirelessly using Miracast with Teams Rooms on Windows devices including touch boards. Available in Teams Rooms Pro.
